status.en: 31 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 107% more than the week before, most of them in Darfur, Khartoum and Kordofan.
status.nb: 31 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 107 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Darfur, Khartoum og Kordofan.

summary.en: The RSF imposed a night curfew in Sennar as fighting intensified in the Blue Nile, while drone strikes near aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan caused civilian casualties. RSF forces closed in on Ed Damazin, prompting Burhan to reassure residents, and a protester was killed in Darfur during a demonstration. Humanitarian conditions worsened as most charity kitchens in Khartoum shut, leaving many facing starvation, and a Christian girl was killed by her brother while trying to escape a forced marriage. The conflict resulted in 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsen innførte nattlig portforbud i Sennar da kampene intensiverte i Blue Nile, mens droneangrep nær hjelpekontorer i Nyala og et tilfluktssted i Vest-Kordofan forårsaket sivile tap. RSF-styrker nærmet seg Ed Damazin, noe som fikk Burhan til å berolige innbyggerne, og en demonstrant ble drept i Darfur under en protest. Humanitære forhold forverret seg da de fleste veldedige kjøkken i Khartoum stengte, og mange står nå i fare for sult, og en kristen jente ble drept av sin bror mens hun forsøkte å flykte fra et tvangsægteskap. Konflikten resulterte i 4 680 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
